LanguageData.RT_IS2_Vehicle.label: IS-2 Obr.1945
LanguageData.RT_IS2_Vehicle.description:
Soviet heavy breakthrough tank featuring a powerful 122mm D-25T gun and a rooftop 12.7mm DShK anti-aircraft machine gun.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Loader x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 122mm D-25T Cannon: 122mmHowitzer Cannon shell (HE / APHE) - 12.7mm DShK AA MG: 12.7x108mm cartridge (FMJ / AP / HE / Sabot) - 7.62mm Coaxial DT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
